instruction: You are given a solid block template `/home/user/Desktop/rigid_base.inp`. Complete the following from the command line: 1. Modify and generate `/home/user/Desktop/rigid.inp`: Please save the final input file as /home/user/Desktop/rigid.inp. - Define reference node 9 (`50, 5, 5`) as the rigid-body reference point - Set all nodes as rigidly connected - Apply `FY=-100 N` at node 9 - Constrain node 1 with `U1=U2=U3=0` (pinned support, rotation allowed) 2. Submit the job and write a post-processing script to parse `rigid.dat`: - Extract node-9 `UY` (rigid-body translation) - Extract maximum and minimum `UY` over all nodes - Write to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` in this format: `ref_uy,max_node_uy,min_node_uy` [Software] Run `ccx --version` or invoke the installed `ccx` binary from a terminal. On this machine, use `/usr/bin/ccx` for the CalculiX solve and `/usr/bin/cgx` when CGX processing is needed.
